name: the world's clock runs at two minutes to the watched second

steps.note: a world opens at eight in the morning on day one, and the corner says so

steps.shot: a world that has just opened

steps.note: 1920 ticks is thirty seconds of watching at 64Hz, and thirty seconds of
watching is an hour of world: the clock should read about nine o'clock
and eight more minutes of watching is the rest of the day: past midnight,
which is the point of showing which day it is beside the time

steps.shot: day two, an hour after midnight

steps.note: somebody spawned into the middle of the night is spawned at that time too
